info.name: arTaH
info.note: sidDAntakOmudyAm asya DAtoH arTaH 'upasargAt AvizkAra, anupasargAcca' iti uktaH asti . ityukte, ayaM DAtuH upasargasya upasTitO anupasTitO vA 'AvizkAraH (pratiSabdaH)' asminneva arTe prayujyate - iti ASayaH . tatrEva 'cAt BazaRe' ityuktvA asya DAtoH BazaRArTaH api anumanyate .

info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to utter, to sound, to explain

info.name: hindI arTa
info.value: Sabda karanA, BAzaRa karanA, prakawa karanA

info.name: DAturUpanandinIwippaRI
info.value: upasargAt paraH SabdaDAtuH AvizkAre vartate ityarTaH . pratiSabdati . pratiSrutimAvizkaroti ityarTaH . anupasargAcca AvizkAre ityeva . cAdBAzaRe .
